title: Recorded this literally outside so sorry for the background noise- bu...
transcript: Masquerade just announced a Halloween party and here is everything you need to know. it actually sounds very similar to the opening night gala and soiree that they did that I got to attend. Normally the first showing for masquerade is seven PM, but to accommodate the party afterwards, they are starting an hour earlier. The first show starting at six PM and the last show starting at 7:15. Now in terms of prices, you could buy a ticket to the show and the party or just the party, with the show and party tickets being 3:45, about $100 more than the normal ticket and party only tickets being $145, with a late night option for 95. As for what the party itself includes, it just lists a DJ dancing and an open bar. This is a 21+ event. Now the opening night soiree also included activities like tattoos, a tarot reading, and caricatures, as well as dancers and photos in front of the famous chandelier. Now there is obviously no guarantee that this one will include all of the same things, but if it is anything like the opening night soiree, I definitely think it is worth the hundred dollar price tag. And I mean, what better place to spend your Halloween?
